description: Empirical output-power vs time lookup for a Ni-63 betavoltaic cell. Power follows isotope decay P(t)=P0*exp(-ln2*t/t_half) with P0 = A0*E_beta*eta_capture*eta_conv. Long, slow exponential decline over decades.
source: Blanovsky, A.E. (2012) IEEE AERO; Olsen et al. (1993) Nucl. Instrum. Methods; Sychov et al. (2008) Appl. Radiat. Isot.

isotope.note: Nickel-63 beta emitter (reused from EC222 F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: time since manufacture (years) -> output electrical power (nW)

power_nW.note: Beginning-of-life output ~181 nW for 0.1 Ci Ni-63 diamond cell
